usedFor: Attio holds records, notes and tasks, and Google Docs receives that text through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Note Created” in Attio, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A new note is plain text, so it drops straight into a document tab for the team.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can overwrite a tab's existing content, so test it on a spare tab first.
